title: Conveyor Belt Peril
front_description: On Geonosis to rescue Obi-Wan, Anakin and Padmé could use a little rescuing themselves. Padmé struggles to maintain her on the conveyor belt that leads to the droid factory, narrowly avoiding stamping machines and welders. Anakin, meantime, is fighting off a small army of Geonosians with his lightsaber. As the two valiant heroes struggle for survival, loyal droids R2-D2 and C-3PO show up to try and help their human allies.
back_description: An original production illustration by Dermot Power of Padmé's white jump-suit.
